primary_references.title: Information Set Monte Carlo Tree Search
primary_references.relevant_evidence: Information-set search shares statistics across hidden states. Determinization can allow incompatible decisions across indistinguishable states and sample histories made unlikely by opponent actions.

primary_references.title: Monte-Carlo Planning in Large POMDPs
primary_references.relevant_evidence: History-based rollout/search combined with sampled hidden states and simulator particle updates; convergence discussion assumes the appropriate belief distribution.

own_inference_for_bluff.training_only_candidate_method: Global permutation of never-seen one-deck physical card identities, applied coherently to current hands/pile/pending and opponent private card histories; fix every card in own current hand, complete own private history, and public revealed batches. Reconstruct actor memories from transformed filtered histories.
own_inference_for_bluff.pairing: Reuse the same sampled hidden world and future RNG streams across all candidate actions within one trial. Keep fixed own/public feature vectors.
needed_checks: Exact own complete observation and feature/candidate equality
Deck UID/card conservation and pending batch inclusion
No mutations of original state or shared immutable histories
All public reveals, own private card histories and deductions remain unchanged
Replay/reconstruction of actors and future legal actions; historical trace references require explicit treatment
Count augmentable unseen cards/states per phase and style
Compare baseline and exact selected checkpoint on fresh real games
own_inference_for_bluff.posterior_limitation: Uniform public-consistent augmentation is not an exact opponent-policy-conditioned posterior. Historical action likelihoods and earlier sealed challenge votes constrain hidden worlds; label augmentation must retain this caveat and pass real-game gates.
own_inference_for_bluff.strategy_fusion_control: Future actors must receive only their own/public observations. No future action optimizer may inspect all hidden hands. Averaging hidden-state rewards is allowed only as training labels.
